meta.method: JD3.speaker adult preset shapes fetched BEFORE vtlSetAnatomyFromAge(60, male) (the age API drops the shape library), then vtlGetTransferFunction (16384-pt, sr=44100, df=2.69 Hz), F1-F3 peak-picked in 150-5500 Hz; per-vowel plausibility gate: min area >= 0.10 cm^2 and child/adult F1,F2 ratios in [1.0, 1.7], else Vorperian & Kent 2007 literature fallback

meta.revision_20260826: Phase 1 (MOUTH v2 build): /a/ retargeted from VTL (757.5/1751.5) to literature (1000/1600). Evidence: (1) VTL's child/adult F1 ratio for /a/ is 758/669 = 1.13 where measured children run ~1.4 (V&K 2007 age-5 /a/ F1 ~1000-1030) -- the Phase-0 plausibility gate [1.0,1.7] was too loose to catch it; (2) the Story & Bunton 2018 geometry (the project's geometry authority) puts child /a/ F1 at 1323 Hz through the verified lossless hard-wall analytic2 engine (published 4yr column: 1368), physically incompatible with 758. VTL raw values remain in meta.vtl_child_raw. The S&B-vs-literature residual (~+25% on /a/ F1 in a lossless hard-wall model) is a documented model-class disagreement, NOT hidden by this revision.
